# First run, as a brand-new user
start app.kurotoon.dev
sleep 3
shot welcome
tapx Next
shot storage
tapx "Select a folder"
sleep 3
shot picker
tap "More options" 25
shot picker_menu
tap "New folder"
shot newfolder
type Kurotoon
tapx OK
sleep 2
shot infolder
tap "Use this folder" 15
sleep 2
tap Allow
sleep 2
shot storage_done
tapx Next
shot permissions
tapx Next
shot guides
tap "Get started"
sleep 3
shot home
tapx Browse
sleep 2
shot browse
tapx Library
shot library
tapx Updates
shot updates
tapx Me
shot me
tapx Home
# Add the community extension repo through the standard deep link
view "tachiyomi://add-repo?url=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keiyoushi/extensions/repo/index.min.json"
sleep 3
shot addrepo_dialog
tapx Add
sleep 4
shot after_addrepo
back
tapx Home
tap "Add sources"
sleep 8
shot extensions
tap Search
type MangaDex
sleep 3
shot ext_search
tapx Install
sleep 12
shot install_prompt
tapx Install
sleep 20
shot installed
tapx Install
sleep 5
shot installed2
back
back
tapx Home
sleep 10
shot home_with_source
scrollup
shot home_scrolled
tapx Browse
sleep 3
shot browse_sources
tap MangaDex
sleep 12
shot source_popular
tapx Latest
sleep 10
shot source_latest
tapxy 270 1000
sleep 10
shot manga
scrollup
shot manga_chapters
scrolldown
scrolldown
tap "Add to library"
sleep 3
shot added
tap "Start"
sleep 15
shot reader
tapxy 540 1200
sleep 2
shot reader_menu
tapxy 540 1200
scrollup
scrollup
shot reader_scrolled
back
sleep 2
shot manga_after_read
back
back
tapx Library
sleep 2
shot library_after
tapx Updates
shot updates_after
tapx Me
shot me_after
tapx Home
sleep 4
shot home_after
